plan.name: Validate comparisons once and store derived evidence once
plan.summary: Complete #717 in one plumbing PR: expose a detached canonical Comparison.Validated result, have Validate delegate to it, and reuse one comparison recomputation inside each Proposal.ValidateReader for the current candidate and both Target.baseline and comparison_baseline requirements, while standalone validation boundaries revalidate mutable inputs and retain every source-pin, full-lock, view, bounds, chart, limitation, occurrence and fingerprint check without changing canonical comparison bytes or existing proposal, lock, reader and verification identities. Use one statechart qualification helper across check feedback, comparison Markdown/SVG, receipts and dashboard messages, preserving literal text, names, exact identities, both scopes and legends, and one tla.ValidIncludeName(name, module) rule for ASCII sibling identifiers ending in .tla and distinct from the main module, retaining regular-file and link checks at I/O boundaries. Only project .invariant/reader.json changes to an ordinary version-1 reader with comparison_ref {version:1,file:"comparison.json",fingerprint:<comparison fingerprint>} and no inline comparison: Current.ReadReader resolves and validates that fixed sibling and reconstructs the unchanged in-memory Reader, accepts historical inline evidence with agreement required for any sibling, rejects missing, malformed, unsafe or mismatched referenced evidence explicitly, and preserves optional legacy readers and stale cleanup; proposals, formalization records, factory markers, receipts and receipt reader companions remain self-contained. Stage previous derived evidence solely in previous/proposal.json, retain separate editable model/includes/view, point drafting guidance there and move the evidence assertion in reader_603_accept_test.go to the complete proposal record, preserving revisions, partial answers, amendments, recovery and publication without granting staged files authority. Update SPEC.md and docs/statecharts.md with recorded D-0345, D-0351, D-0355 and D-0362 citations and the storage, validation, staging and shared-qualification contracts; the merger records the new policy, and the build adds exhaustive mutation regressions and focused validation benchmarks with base/candidate measurements, runs the affected Go packages and persistence/recovery/receipt suites, and lists the documented pinned-TLC integration check as Merger work only if Docker is unavailable.

tests.name: TestComparison717ProjectReferenceRoundTrip
tests.says: Ratified project readers store only a fixed versioned fingerprint reference, reconstruct exactly the original Reader without mutating the proposal or lock, and keep receipts and formalization records self-contained; ordinary and legacy rewrites clear stale comparisons.

tests.name: TestComparison717ReferencedEvidenceRefusesDamage
tests.says: References refuse missing, malformed, unsupported, mismatched and linked sibling evidence explicitly; old inline readers load with or without a sibling only when any sibling agrees, and failed reads cannot silently substitute a comparison.

tests.name: TestComparison717PreviousHasOneDerivedRecord
tests.says: Revisions and amendments stage the full previous proposal once with separate source files and guidance, without previous reader or comparison exports, and retain sources through saved results and partial-answer carriers.

tests.name: TestComparison717ValidatedSnapshotsRejectMutations
tests.says: Validated returns detached canonical evidence with unchanged bytes and fingerprints, refuses mutation of every comparison field after a successful validation, and retains pin, full-lock, view, bounds, chart, limitation and duplicate occurrence checks.

tests.name: TestComparison717ReaderBindingsSurviveRoundTrip
tests.says: A reference-loaded Reader still rejects comparison tampering, mismatched candidates and each required baseline independently after prior success, including when the outer reader fingerprint is resealed; standalone context validation never trusts prior validation.

tests.name: TestComparison717QualificationsAcrossPublishers
tests.says: Check feedback, Markdown, SVG, receipt notes and artifacts, and dashboard proposal and receipt messages carry identical qualifications for unchanged, view, model/include, bound and limited comparisons while preserving hostile and Unicode text, identities, source names and independent final-model provenance.

tests.name: TestComparison717SharedIncludeNames
tests.says: The common TLA sibling-name rule accepts ASCII underscore identifiers and rejects main-module collisions, absolute and relative paths, either separator, Unicode identifiers and malformed suffixes.
